title: Clinical Trial Scheme of Shu Gan yi Yang Capsule
brief_summary: Shu gan yi yang capsule is made of traditional Chinese medicine Guizhou Yi Bai pharmaceutical Limited by Share Ltd, for liver and kidney deficiency and liver and kidney deficiency and blood stasis caused by functional impotence and mild arterial insufficiency in impotence, impotence, flaccid penis not hard or lift and not firm, chest deep sigh, chest fullness, soreness and weakness of waist and knees, pale tongue or petechiae, pulse string or string. The choice of depression associated with erectile dysfunction patients, and investigate its effect.In this study, patients with depression and erectile dysfunction were selected and the efficacy was investigated
